2607.28319.title: Fairness Pruning: Locating Demographic Bias in GLU-MLP Layers via Differential Activations
2607.28319.paper_summary: This work presents Fairness Pruning, a lightweight structural intervention method designed for the management and future mitigation of demographic bias in large language models (LLMs). As a foundational empirical validation of this method, this work focuses on causal bias localization. Using minimally contrastive prompt pairs and inference-time activation capture, the method identifies neurons that react differentially when processing demographic attributes in GLU architectures, evaluating the signal at the down_proj input. Empirical evaluation was conducted on models of up to 3 billion parameters (Llama-3.2 family and Salamandra-2B), combining standardized benchmark evaluation with qualitative text generation experiments. Results demonstrate that zeroing the identified neurons alters how the model responds to associated demographic variables. However, rather than producing flat mitigation, the intervention causes bidirectional bias destabilization: because BiasScore is unsigned, candidate sets mix neurons that push toward and against the stereotype, and the net effect on aggregate bias depends on which sign dominates. The intervention is extremely surgical: zeroing at most 40 neurons in Llama-3.2-1B (less than 0.031% of total MLP width) achieves a mean retention of 99.49% in reasoning and general knowledge capabilities. These findings empirically confirm that demographic bias processing and model capabilities operate on dissociable circuits, establishing the methodological foundations for transitioning from blind zeroing toward directional behavior modulation.
2607.28319.paper_summary_zh: 這項工作提出了公平修剪（Fairness Pruning），這是一種輕量級的結構性干預方法，旨在管理和未來減輕大型語言模型（LLMs）中的人口統計偏見。作為對這種方法的基礎實證驗證，這項工作專注於因果偏見定位。通過使用最小對比的提示對和推理時的激活捕獲，該方法識別在處理GLU架構中的人口統計屬性時反應不同的神經元，並在down_proj輸入處評估信號。對最多擁有30億參數的模型（Llama-3.2家族和Salamandra-2B）進行了實證評估，結合了標準化基準評估和定性文本生成實驗。結果顯示，將識別出的神經元歸零會改變模型對相關人口統計變量的反應。然而，這種干預並沒有產生平坦的減輕效果，而是導致雙向偏見不穩定：由於BiasScore是無符號的，候選集混合了推向和反對刻板印象的神經元，對總體偏見的淨影響取決於哪個符號佔主導地位。這種干預非常精確：在Llama-3.2-1B中最多歸零40個神經元（不到0.031%的總MLP寬度）可在推理和一般知識能力中實現99.49%的平均保留率。這些發現實證確認了人口統計偏見處理和模型能力在可分離的電路上運作，為從盲目歸零過渡到定向行為調節建立了方法論基礎。
